descriptive: user 2026-11-26 ~20:18 and ~21:05 in whip-lead's chat (readthrough fill); values per task beside the fine-tunes, no verdict on reuse or new, no counts of comparisons in figures or text

settings.seeds_source: the fine-tunes' own seeds s0-s2 (known3.json): seed s draws the recipe's batches exactly as fine-tune s did (finetune_arm_a's torch.Generator(seed) draw; lowercase.batch_order(rows, seed))
settings.subspace_seed_source: chosen here, a label only: the subspace of seed s is drawn from 287000 + s (U then V per matrix in sorted order, QR of a float64 Gaussian, commute.subspace)
settings.lora_rank_source: plan: the trainable count of a rank-8 LoRA on the same 24 matrices (Hu et al. 2021's common small rank); k = round(sqrt(8 (out + in))): 111 on the 16 attention matrices (768 x 768), 175 on the 8 MLP matrices (3072 x 768, 768 x 3072); 442,136 trainable against the LoRA's 442,368 (and the full fine-tune's 28,311,552)
settings.lr_mults_source: Fable 2026-11-26 (in-the-weeds choice): Adam's per-step change of the subspace update is about lr x k per matrix against lr x sqrt(out x in) for the full fine-tune, so x10 matches the fine-tune's per-step size and x1 would be a wasted point; x1000 would move ~4.5 per matrix per step. Multipliers of each recipe's own lr (3e-5 in every recipe)
settings.grid_task_source: the lead's brief (e62/copy seed 0). Fable advised the task whose fine-tune reaches gain 1 latest instead: noted as an open question, not taken
settings.reach_by_source: Fable 2026-11-26: the pick rule (run.py `pick`): the lowest multiplier whose run first reaches held-out gain >= 1 by step 100; else the lowest reaching it by step 300; else the multiplier with the largest held-out gain. The lowest that reaches overshoots least; the step-100 bar leaves room for slower tasks and seeds
settings.steps_source: every recipe's length: keydep.finetune and elicit_ft train 300 steps (E12_CHECKS[-1]) whatever step they keep; lowercase.arm_b_states 300 (STEPS); run.py asserts both
settings.target_gain_source: the log-odds share's floor, local_faith.MIN_GAIN (one-sided gain >= 1); run.py asserts it
settings.loss_window_source: the brief: the loss falls over the first 50 steps (mean of steps 1-5 against steps 46-50), logged only: the fine-tunes' own first-50-step losses are not saved, so no bar is filed
settings.kl_batch_source: E228's batch for kl_of, as P2.82 (memory only)
settings.recipes_source: per task, the code that trained its fine-tunes (inventories: share_untrained/results/inventory.json, known_3seeds.inventories, refit_96key.inventories); run.py Trainer.recipe reuses finetune.arm_a_loss / next_token_ce and the recipes' data, draws and settings; only the parameterisation and the lr change
settings.e62_copy_source: induction_cue (E62) stage c: keydep.finetune(ctx, w, seed, E12_CHECKS) on windows.pt's train windows with the copy target as a last column (copying.with_target, table data.LAST, ci_len 41); arm A, Adam 3e-5, batch 32, KL weight 1, clip 1, 300 steps; fine-tune kept at step 30
settings.e46_ident32_source: known_3seeds.train group e46 (E12 arm A, keydep.elicit_ft) on regating_table/results/large/windows_ident32.pt; Adam 3e-5, batch 32, KL weight 1, clip 1, 300 steps; fine-tune kept at the first of 10/30/100/300 with held-out P(target) >= 0.5
settings.e53_lowercase_source: known_3seeds.train group e53 = performed_anchor (E53): lowercase.arm_b_states(model, device, lowercase.task(...), 'adam', seed, (300,)): next-token CE on 2,400 lowercased Pile train rows, Adam 3e-5, batch 8, each row once in batch_order(seed), clip 1, 300 steps; fine-tune kept at step 300 in bf16
settings.e54_elicit_source: keydependent_elicit (s0, s1) and keydependent_patch (s2) seed_states: keydep.elicit_ft on keydependent_elicit/results/large/windows_elicit.pt; E12 arm A as above; kept by E12's p >= 0.5 rule
settings.c3_rank1_source: open_pair amend1.py stage C1: keydep.elicit_ft on open_pair/results/large/amend1/windows_rank1_trained.pt, seeds 0-2; E12 arm A as above
settings.c3_copy_source: open_pair amend1.py stage C1: keydep.elicit_ft on open_pair/results/large/amend1/windows_copy_trained.pt, seeds 0-2; E12 arm A as above
settings.e58_rank1_source: refit_96key (E147) stage 0b: keydep.finetune(ctx, w, seed, (30,)) on open_pair/results/large/amend3/windows_rank1_trained.pt; E12 arm A as above (300 steps run); fine-tune kept at step 30
settings.e58_copy_source: refit_96key (E147) stage 0b: keydep.finetune(ctx, w, seed, (30,)) on open_pair/results/large/amend3/windows_copy_trained.pt; as e58/rank1
settings.gain_eval_source: held-out gain = the reader's own T (local_faith.route_cells: mean log-odds of the trained answer on E136's read windows, compute_ci's bf16 forward, the read's batches and ci_len) at W0 + the bf16-rounded update minus at W0, read after every step (Fable 2026-11-26: every step bounds the at-1 overshoot to one step). The fine-tunes were kept on their own rules (above), not at a first gain >= 1

parameterisation: on each of the 24 decomposed matrices W (out x in): fixed random orthonormal U (out x k) and V (in x k), trainable Z (k x k) from 0, update U Z V^T added by a forward hook during training (commute.subspace); the target weights never change during training. The scored and saved update is U Z V^T rounded to bf16
states: at1: the first step whose held-out gain >= 1 (absent if none); end: step 300. Both scored; at-1 carries the rules

rules.task_mean: per task, the mean at-1 share (P2.82's Reader `r`: (L01 - L00) / gain, nan unless the reader's gain >= 1) over the seeds whose at-1 state exists and reads a finite share; one seed is its own mean; no such seed: 'no comparable null', the task left out with its largest held-out gain
rules.reading: over the tasks with a mean (n_scored): n_scored < 5: 'too few tasks' (reported as read, no call); more than half with mean >= 0.65: 'rival a'; more than half with mean <= 0.42: 'rival b'; else 'between'. 0.65 > 0.42, so at most one rival holds. experiments/subspace_share/rules.py; its edge cases (no task, every task without a mean, one seed, nan shares, ties at both bars, 4-4 splits, too few tasks) pass by `python rules.py`
rules.rival_a: the card's rival a (the share reads the task's prior skill, not how the update was built): subspace updates at gain >= 1 read shares near the fine-tunes' reuse values (0.75-1.10 in known3.json) on most reuse tasks; the bar 0.65 sits 0.1 (the card's smallest gap) under the lowest reuse value, 0.75
rules.rival_b: the card's rival b (the share picks out structure full fine-tunes find): the subspace updates read well under the fine-tunes, near the new-side values (0.12-0.42 in known3.json) or near 0; the bar is the top of the new-side range
rules.end: the same rule on the step-300 states, reported beside, descriptive only

expected.control_zero: a zero change on each of the 8 reuse tasks' rows: gain, numerator and KL exactly 0; share nan (gain under the floor) in both the one-sided form and route_split's own (P2.82's control, results/control.json)
expected.control_fine_tunes: each of the 24 reuse fine-tunes' route_split share equals its known3.json value exactly (float equality; same code, file, rows and card type, NVIDIA L40, as P2.82's control passed); a miss stops the run
expected.step0_gain: every training's held-out gain at Z = 0 reads exactly 0 (W0 + a zero update is W0); a miss stops the run
expected.T0_minus_reader: the training eval's W0 log-odds minus the reader's base T on the same task: exactly 0 (same forward, batches and sums); logged and recorded, not a stop
expected.eval_minus_reader_gain: on each scored state, the training eval's gain minus the reader's: exactly 0 (same bf16-rounded update, forward and rows); logged and recorded, not a stop
expected.at1_gain: every at-1 state reads a reader gain >= 1 (it was kept at the first step whose identical eval read >= 1), so its share is finite
expected.step1_norm: Adam's first step moves each Z entry with a nonzero gradient by about lr, so ||dW|| at step 1 ~ lr x sqrt(442,136) = 665 lr: 0.20 at x10, 0.60 at x30, 2.0 at x100 (bf16 rounding and zero-gradient entries make it a little smaller); the fine-tune's first step was about 3e-5 x sqrt(28.3M) = 0.16
expected.loss: the recipe's loss falls from steps 1-5 to steps 46-50 at the chosen multiplier (logged, no bar)
expected.lrgrid: no expectation filed for which multiplier reaches gain 1 first; the pick rule above
expected.reach: no expectation filed: some tasks' seeds may not reach gain 1 in 300 steps; each is reported with its largest held-out gain and share nan
expected.norm_rel: no expectation filed: the subspace update's size against its fine-tune's is reported beside its share, with KL against the fine-tune's

blind_to: one subspace size class (rank-8-LoRA trainable count) and one lr multiplier for all tasks; at-1 is a gain of about 1, far under the fine-tunes' own gains (1.6-23 log-odds), so the comparison is at matched output floor, not matched gain; the fine-tunes were kept by their own step rules, not at a first gain >= 1; 3 seeds per task; one decomposition (the released VPD); the reuse side only (no new-side subspace updates)
positive_control: stage control: the zero change (exact 0, share nan) and the 24 reuse fine-tunes reproduced bit for bit by the same reader
noise_floor: none needed for the controls (exact); for the rules, E161's batch sd of the log-odds share, 0.0314 (experiments/share_stability/results/run.json, the card's spread), well under the 0.23 between the bars
